title: Shikayat — your AI consumer advocate.
reset: Start with a clean sandbox before the demonstration.
input: One screenshot and one line in Hinglish.
facts: Shikayat extracts the facts, assesses the case and suggests a complaint route.
preview: Real users send from their own email. This goes to a test company inbox.
waiting: Waiting for a real reply from the test company inbox.
forensics: Forwarded to the team is not a resolution. Acknowledged ≠ Resolved.
offer: Simulated reply: it compares the offer with what you asked for. You decide.
promise: Simulated reply: now they have committed to a date, and Shikayat holds them to it.
missed: Simulated time: the missed promise and the next action are shown on the case board.
proof: Measured against a held-out set, published honestly.
end: AI reads. Rules decide. You approve.
